designNotes: Built for the source world dark steampunk fantasy: infrastructure, transit, divine containment, ichor economies, guilds, and living NPC schedules.
D&D 5e equipment expectations are mapped into storefronts: weapons, armor, adventuring gear, tools, mounts/vehicles, trade goods, lifestyle expenses, and magic item access.

Capital Cities may include portal network buildings. Cities and Capital Cities may include skyship docks. Underwater settlements use pressure-sealed guest architecture and aquatic substitutes for land agriculture and stables.
Locations are suitable as pins, map regions, NPC workplaces/homes/visiting destinations, services containers, and rerollable generator pools.

docProfiles.title: Capital City - Canyon Valley
docProfiles.summary: Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.
docProfiles.identity: cliff roads, rope bridges, switchback caravan yards, river-bottom markets, echo inns, gorge rail trestles, wind shelters, pulley lifts, and canyon rescue posts.
docProfiles.market: grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.
docProfiles.availability: Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.
docProfiles.categories: Hostels; Inns; Taverns; Restaurants; Hotels; General Stores; Marketplaces; Armories; Blacksmiths; Craft Shops; Stables; Hospitals; Apothecaries; Alchemists; Magic Item Shops; Jewelers; Furniture Halls; Textile and Clothing Shops; Pet Sellers; Courier and Guild Offices; Housing Office; Skyship Station; Portal Network Building
rules: Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls.
Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces.
Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths.

Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists.
Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards.

Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters.
Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.
